question: Which additional classes of celestial beings are included in the revealed cosmic vision?
premises: Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas are named.
The address marks this as part of the teaching to the beloved.
inference: The vision includes Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas.
plain_english: Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas, O beloved.
